notes: Game abilities that real sign-offs unlock (framework section 5). The real technique names come from the school's curriculum; these are the generic powers they map to, in belt order. The 1st belt's kata unlocks stances[1], the 2nd belt's stances[2], and so on; each belt's kick combo unlocks the next strike; each self-defense technique unlocks the next seal (5 per belt). stances[0] is the Beginner's Stance everyone starts with. Belts beyond the end of a list still unlock their ability, with its power arriving in a later update. Effect types are listed in packages/sim/src/effects.ts. Virtues: each stripe word maps to one Virtue. The reason behind each choice is in docs/decisions.md (milestone 4).

stances.name: Beginner's Stance
stances.text: Steady and even. Good at everything.

stances.name: Cat Stance
stances.text: Quicker Counters and Dash, but softer blocks.

stances.name: Front Stance
stances.text: Hit harder, but move a little slower.

stances.name: Fighting Stance
stances.text: Strong blocks and fast Focus, but a shorter Dash.

stances.name: Horse Stance
stances.text: Stand still to hit harder, but move slower.

strikes.name: Follow-up Kick
strikes.text: Your STRIKE adds a second kick.

strikes.name: Quick Combo
strikes.text: Practiced combos flow smoothly: each STRIKE costs 8 less Focus.

seals.name: Off-Balance
seals.text: Perfect Counters leave the attacker off-balance half a second longer.

seals.name: Escape Step
seals.text: A Block instantly recharges DASH, so you can get away.

seals.name: Sweep
seals.text: Perfect Counters also knock into enemies close by.

seals.name: Sharp Eyes
seals.text: The Perfect Counter window is 1 tick longer.

seals.name: Create Distance
seals.text: Blocks shove the attacker back, bouncing 20% of the hit back at them.

seals.name: Disarm
seals.text: After a Perfect Counter, that attacker's next attack does half damage.

virtues.name: Shield of Respect
virtues.text: A shield that soaks up {n} damage for {s} seconds.

virtues.name: Second Wind
virtues.text: Restores {pct} of your Health and gives back half your Focus.

virtues.name: Perfect Discipline
virtues.text: For {s} seconds, every COUNTER is a Perfect Counter.
